priority_classes.name: Primary subject
priority_classes.objective: preserve identity, visibility, intended exposure and local color

priority_classes.name: Supporting subject
priority_classes.objective: remain legible without competing with P1

priority_classes.name: Atmosphere / context
priority_classes.objective: preserve time, weather, depth and scene intent

priority_classes.name: Potential distraction
priority_classes.objective: attenuate only when measured dominance conflicts with P1–P3

estimation_signals.use: face count, area, sharpness and gaze/placement; never identity recognition
estimation_signals.risk: small distant faces may be missed

estimation_signals.use: object mask area plus contrast/focus relative to neighbors
center, thirds and edge proximity as weak priors only
region edge energy relative to depth peers
combine scene labels, subject evidence and atmosphere protections

examples.desired: Expose people naturally; retain snow brightness/texture and cloudy winter atmosphere.
Keep the scene nocturnal; modestly constrain glare without claiming clipped-core recovery.
Protect an already-correct person; improve recoverable waterfall/foliage detail without removing atmosphere.
Do not lift intentional silhouette; protect warm gradients and clipped sun core.

decision_rule: Brightness, size, and centrality are independent weak cues; no single cue establishes P1.
